Color Win puzzle captcha images

Expected files:
  captcha-01.png
  captcha-02.png
  captcha-03.png
  captcha-04.png
  captcha-05.png
  captcha-06.png
  captcha-07.png
  captcha-08.png

Folder used by the app:
  dist/assets/captcha/

You can replace any image while keeping the same filename.
Recommended source image: landscape, at least 1200x780 px.
The captcha canvas uses object-cover style rendering, so larger landscape images are fine too.
